dialogues.speaker: Apuaq
dialogues.text: Ifelayo, why don't we head to Tete Isle next?

dialogues.speaker: Ifelayo
dialogues.text: Anything's fine. Let's go to Villa Guiztli.

dialogues.speaker: Apuaq
dialogues.text: So... is anything fine, or do you want to go to Villa Guiztli?

dialogues.speaker: Ifelayo
dialogues.text: Anything's fine means anything's fine. Everyone says there are some unique locals living at Villa Guiztli — doesn't it sound fun?

dialogues.speaker: Apuaq
dialogues.text: If "anything" is "fine", then why don't we go with my suggestion?

dialogues.speaker: Apuaq
dialogues.text: I heard Tete Isle has this bar, Me & Dew, where you can experience clairvoyance by drinking one of their drinks. It might be a limited-time thing, you know? Meanwhile, we can go to Villa Guiztli any time you want.

dialogues.speaker: Ifelayo
dialogues.text: Whatever, anything's fine. I'm thinking we should check out Colorfall Cliffs, and try the Airborne Asha experience...

dialogues.speaker: Apuaq
dialogues.text: Do you even know what "anything's fine" means!?
